subject.title: feat(memory): add multi-slot memory role architecture

question: Which proposed memory roles and legacy migration behavior should become supported public plugin/config contracts in this change?
rationale: The patch creates permanent role names, per-agent selection semantics, runtime ownership rules, and compatibility behavior, while some proposed roles still lack complete generic lifecycle protocols.

options.title: Land mature roles first
options.body: Adopt only roles with complete runtime contracts, likely recall and compaction, and defer capture, dreaming, and userModel until their protocols are defined.

options.title: Approve all five roles
options.body: Adopt the full taxonomy after completing each role contract, removing steady-state legacy fallback, narrowing the branch, and proving the final head.

options.title: Design generic capabilities
options.body: Pause role-specific keys and instead define manifest-declared capability ownership that can support future memory responsibilities without more fixed slots.

recommendation.title: Land mature roles first
recommendation.body: Adopt only roles with complete runtime contracts, likely recall and compaction, and defer capture, dreaming, and userModel until their protocols are defined.

likelyOwner.reason: Current-main provenance connects this person to the existing slot contract and both affected user-facing memory references, making them the strongest available decision-routing candidate.
